name: PresenceIndicator
title: Components/Data Display/PresenceIndicator
description: Display host-provided availability with a visible label by default. Dot-only presence has an accessible name. Presence is not a record workflow status, a connectivity probe, or a live announcement service.
purpose: Display host-provided availability with a visible label by default. Dot-only presence has an accessible name. Presence is not a record workflow status, a connectivity probe, or a live announcement service.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Use only when another accessible label already conveys presence.

props.name: label
props.description: Localized accessible and visible text. Defaults to the status name.
